name: zyx-authoring-mcp
description: Orchestrate Source Pack to Idea and Product Bundles, with independent Question Bank authoring through the Zyx MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Author Zyx content through the MCP quality gates.
interface.longDescription: Provides one end-to-end authoring pipeline and four independently invocable specialist skills for prompt-only Source Pack, Idea Bundle, Product Bundle, and Question Bank authoring. The remote MCP server remains the authority for authentication, schema validation, provenance, quality gates, and staging.
defaultPrompt: Run or resume the end-to-end authoring pipeline from course sources through validated Idea and Product Bundles.
Build a Source Pack from stored course PDFs and validate it through Zyx MCP.
Author an Idea Bundle from a validated Source Pack.
Author a Product Bundle from published Ideas.
Author an Idea-linked Question Bank draft for admin review.
